description: Validation rules for Direct Debit Transfer (pacs.003) under SWIFT CBPR+ SR2026. Key change: unstructured postal addresses are no longer accepted; hybrid or fully structured addresses required.

rules.name: PostalAddressStructureMandate
rules.description: From SR2026, fully unstructured addresses (AdrLine only) are no longer permitted. A postal address MUST be either fully structured or hybrid (minimum TwnNm + Ctry required in structured fields).
rules.requirement: PstlAdr MUST contain TwnNm AND Ctry. Use of AdrLine alone (fully unstructured) is rejected.
rules.reference: SWIFT CBPR+ SR2026 Usage Guidelines – Postal Address

rules.name: CountryCodeFormat
rules.description: Country code MUST be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (2 uppercase letters).

rules.name: GroupHeaderMsgIdPresence
rules.description: Message Identification is mandatory and must be unique.

rules.name: GroupHeaderCreationDateTime
rules.description: Creation Date and Time is mandatory. Must be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).

rules.name: NumberOfTransactionsConsistency
rules.description: NbOfTxs must equal the actual count of DrctDbtTxInf blocks in the message.

rules.name: ControlSumConsistency
rules.description: If present, CtrlSum must equal the sum of all DrctDbtTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt values.

rules.name: SettlementMethodPresence
rules.description: Settlement Method is mandatory in GroupHeader.

rules.name: PaymentIdEndToEndId
rules.description: End-to-End Identification is mandatory. If not provided by the originator, use 'NOTPROVIDED'.

rules.name: UETRFormat
rules.description: UETR (Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference) must be a valid RFC 4122 UUID v4.

rules.name: InterBankSettlementAmount
rules.description: Interbank Settlement Amount is mandatory. Must be greater than zero. Currency attribute (Ccy) must be a valid ISO 4217 3-letter code.

rules.name: InterBankSettlementDate
rules.description: Interbank Settlement Date is mandatory. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

rules.name: PaymentTypeInformationLocalInstrument
rules.description: Local Instrument code should be present when applicable for scheme identification (e.g. CORE, B2B for SEPA).

rules.name: SequenceType
rules.description: Sequence Type is mandatory for direct debit. Must be one of the allowed codes.

rules.name: MandateRelatedInformation
rules.description: Mandate Related Information block is mandatory for direct debit transactions.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicator
rules.description: If AmdmntInd is 'true', AmdmntInfDtls must be present with at least one populated amendment detail.
rules.crossFieldRule: if AmdmntInd = true then AmdmntInfDtls must be present

rules.name: CreditorSchemeId
rules.description: Creditor Scheme Identification is recommended for scheme-based direct debits (e.g. SEPA). When used, PrvtId/Othr/SchmeNm/Prtry should indicate the scheme (e.g. 'SEPA').

rules.name: CreditorAgentBIC
rules.description: Creditor Agent BIC must be a valid 8 or 11 character BIC (ISO 9362).

rules.name: DebtorAgentBIC
rules.description: Debtor Agent BIC must be a valid 8 or 11 character BIC (ISO 9362).

rules.name: CreditorNamePresence
rules.description: Creditor Name is mandatory. Max 140 characters.

rules.name: CreditorAccountIBAN
rules.description: Creditor Account Identification is mandatory. IBAN is preferred where applicable.

rules.name: DebtorNamePresence
rules.description: Debtor Name is mandatory. Max 140 characters.

rules.name: DebtorAccountIBAN
rules.description: Debtor Account Identification is mandatory. IBAN is preferred where applicable.

rules.name: PurposeCode
rules.description: Purpose code is recommended. Must be a valid ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code value.

rules.name: RemittanceInformationLength
rules.description: Unstructured remittance information max 140 characters per occurrence.

rules.name: RemittanceStructuredOrUnstructured
rules.description: RmtInf must contain either Ustrd or Strd, not both in the same transaction.

rules.name: ChargesBearer
rules.description: Charges Bearer is mandatory. Must be one of the allowed codes.

rules.name: InstructedAmountCurrencyConsistency
rules.description: If InstructedAmount is present, its currency (Ccy) should be consistent with the account currency of the Debtor, where known.

rules.name: CategoryPurposeCode
rules.description: Category Purpose code, if present, must be a valid ExternalCategoryPurpose1Code.

rules.name: CharacterSetCompliance
rules.description: All text fields must use UTF-8. The SWIFT Latin character set applies for CBPR+ usage: a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and / - ? : ( ) . , ' + space.

rules.name: MessageVersionCheck
rules.description: Message must conform to pacs.003.001.12 (FIToFICustomerDirectDebitV12) namespace.

STRUCTURED.description: All address components in dedicated elements. Preferred format.

HYBRID.description: Mix of structured mandatory elements and up to 2 unstructured AdrLine elements.

UNSTRUCTURED.description: AdrLine only. REJECTED from SR2026 (November 2026 onwards).

references: PMPG Hybrid Postal Address Guidelines v1.10 (Oct 2025)
SWIFT SR2026 Structured Address Mandate – effective November 2026
